label: Composio
hints: Use composio connect <toolkit>, connections, search, read, sync, and knowledge search. The current QM capability binds every call to this exact personal or private-channel scope.
Personal connections must start in that teammate's DM or personal QM chat. Shared connections require a QM org admin in an approved private channel.
Only read-only tools are executable. Drafting, sending, deleting, publishing, and invitations are refused by the gateway.
Never ask for or print a Composio API key. Connector credentials remain in the dedicated server-side Composio project.
